name: Mukta Shukti Bhasma

sections.introduction: Mukta Shukti Bhasma is an ayurvedic herbal formulation. This is formulated from the pearl oyster shell. These are found in Indian Ocean. This is enriched with properties like being antacid and anti-pyretic etc. This is used to treat problems of digestive, respiratory system and heart. This bhasma is rich with mineral elements such as aluminum oxide, magnesium oxide, calcium carbonate and organic matter.
sections.ingredients:
Purified pearl oyster shell 
 Purification method of pearl oyster shell 

 Take oyster shell and dipped in to butter milk for three days. 
 Change the butter milk every day. 
 Place the vessel in the sunlight without its lid means uncovered vessel. 
 After 3 days, take out shell and wash with warm water. 
 Remove the black part of the oyster shell with the help of knife. 
 Now used the white part of the oyster shell. 

 Method of preparation 

 Take purified pearl oyster shell and make its powder by grinding. 
 Now powder is heated in absence of air in 900 degree Celsius for 3 hours. 
 Repeated the process three times. 
 You will get the white coloured Mukta Shukti Bhasma.
sections.dose:
Take 120 to 250 mg one or two times in a day, before or after food. 
 Consume this bhasma with honey, butter, ghee or milk.
sections.indications:
Chronic fever 
 Hyper acidity 
 Constipation 
 Leucorrhea 
 Cough and cold 
 Arthritis 
 Dyspepsia 
 Peptic ulcers 
 Rickets 
 Calcium deficiency
sections.contraindications:
Take under doctor supervision. 
 Avoid over dose. 
 Keep out of reach from children. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Ushirasava (Usheerasava) 
 Reference – Ayurveda prakasha 2/327 
 Introduction 
 Mukta Shukti Bhasma is an ayurvedic herbal formulation. This is formulated from the pearl oyster shell. These are found in Indian Ocean. This is enriched with properties like being antacid and anti-pyretic etc. This is used to treat problems of digestive, respiratory system and heart. This bhasma is rich with mineral elements such as aluminum oxide, magnesium oxide, calcium carbonate and organic matter. 
 Ingredients 
 Purified pearl oyster shell 
 Purification method of pearl oyster shell 
 
 Take oyster shell and dipped in to butter milk for three days. 
 Change the butter milk every day. 
 Place the vessel in the sunlight without its lid means uncovered vessel. 
 After 3 days, take out shell and wash with warm water. 
 Remove the black part of the oyster shell with the help of knife. 
 Now used the white part of the oyster shell. 
 
 Method of preparation 
 
 Take purified pearl oyster shell and make its powder by grinding. 
 Now powder is heated in absence of air in 900 degree Celsius for 3 hours. 
 Repeated the process three times. 
 You will get the white coloured Mukta Shukti Bhasma. 
 
 Dose 
 
 Take 120 to 250 mg one or two times in a day, before or after food. 
 Consume this bhasma with honey, butter, ghee or milk. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Chronic fever 
 Hyper acidity 
 Constipation 
 Leucorrhea 
 Cough and cold 
 Arthritis 
 Dyspepsia 
 Peptic ulcers 
 Rickets 
 Calcium deficiency 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Take under doctor supervision. 
 Avoid over dose. 
 Keep out of reach from children. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
